verdict.rationale: telli provides a REST API with an OpenAPI spec that can be used to generate client libraries, plus webhooks, custom tools, and an MCP server for agent integration, but there is no evidence of telli-maintained official SDKs in specific languages (e.g., Python/JS packages published by telli) — only self-generated clients from the OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: dedicated first-party SDK packages/repos, language-specific SDK documentation, versioning/release notes for such SDKs.
